title: random
text:
random

alesha: quick update — launch traffic held steady through the noon spike. we crossed 12,345,678 total requests today. no SLO breaches reported. tiny victory dance? :dancer:
deploy-bot: release v3.0.0 -> prod (canary passed) :white_check_mark:
greg: wow nice number. makes me want to carve it into a cookie :cookie:
marta: celebrating this Friday? i'm down for anything with sprinkles :confetti_ball:
yuki: suggestion: mini pinata in kitchen. break at 3 for a 5-min sugar break? :pinata:
rachel: +1 pinata. also will bring those retro gummy fish 
sam: can someone start a 2-question poll? cupcakes vs pinata treats. react with :one: or :two:
lina: side note: shoutout to infra for the memcache tweak — p95 latency dropped 18% this morning :rocket: great coordination on the rollout @alesha @sam
ops-bot: added calendar event "launch debrief + treats" 15:00-15:20
alesha: poll open — results in 8m. huge thanks team, that Friday demo looked great in the wild :clap:
greg: whoever wins, photos or it didn't happen. i'm bringing the disposable camera energy 
marta: poll results: :one: cupcakes (7), :two: pinata treats (9) — pinata wins!
yuki: pinata + gummy fish + tiny flags. roof confetti optional if wind is cooperative :wind_face:
rachel: can we also do a 30-second gong at 3pm? tiny, not alarm-level :bell:
sam: noted. i put a tiny gong on the event agenda :metal:
alesha: thanks everyone. small rewards but big thanks. we'll do the pinata, photos, and a brief toast. back to the grind — with extra sugar :grin:
